lessonsProposed: When an overlay temporarily owns a user journey, covered interactive controls should be made inert; visual stacking alone does not remove them from keyboard navigation.

findings.trigger: While a sufficiently long intro is playing and the avatar has become ready, use Tab to move past the visible Skip button and the covered Talk control onto Play.
findings.consequence: Keyboard focus moves to a control hidden behind the opaque intro, so its focus indicator disappears; focusing Play also starts game prefetch even though the intro still owns the interface. Activation is correctly blocked, but the keyboard journey is confusing.
findings.evidence: IntroVideo is mounted as a z-30 visual cover, while the chrome below remains mounted and is not inert during the intro. Play remains focusable when avatarReady and its onFocus handler calls shell.prefetch("focus"); the only intro-specific protection is inside its onClick handler.
findings.rule: Covered controls must be removed from sequential keyboard navigation while an overlay owns interaction; frontend review requires coherent focus order and visible keyboard focus.
